integrity: Claim and proof concern all fields and all n>=2, ell>=2. Direct finite GF(2) tests corroborate but do not replace proof. All public materials have been checked for claim consistency.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly truncated one-arrow oriented cycles only. Standard serial-module and radical-square-zero special cases are prior art; full historical priority and independent proof validation are not established.
title: Ideal-product monoids and central-binomial stabilization for truncated oriented cycles
